cohort: Neonates prenatally diagnosed with CHD from August 2010 to July 2016, compared to gestational age matched controls without CHD
finding: Fetuses with prenatally diagnosed CHD did not experience significantly different cesarean delivery rates, labor and delivery management, or rates of fetal acidosis compared to healthy fetuses.
mod_finding: This study found that fetuses with prenatally diagnosed congenital heart disease (CHD) did not have significantly different cesarean delivery rates compared to healthy fetuses, even in the setting of non-reassuring fetal heart rate tracing.
